fields.description: Unique code for this controller family, e.g. 'CTRL-DMX'

Product Status
fields.options:
Draft
Active
Active + Live
Internal Only
Discontinued
Archived
fields.description: Active: offered to dealers and staff in ERPNext and the portal, not listed on the website. Active + Live: offered the same way and listed on the website through its Webflow Product, which must be linked first. Internal Only: offered to staff only, hidden from dealers and the website. New templates start Internal Only. Draft, Discontinued and Archived are not offered.
Marketing product category (Webflow taxonomy) this template belongs to
fields.label: Product Category
Target Brand
fields.description: The one brand this template is listed under. At most one row can be enabled, and one is required to link a Webflow Product or generate a spec sheet.
Short series code used as the part-number prefix.
fields.label: SKU Series Code
Webflow Product
fields.description: The Webflow Product that lists this template. Pick one while empty; use Actions > Unlink Webflow Product to change it. Required when Product Status is Active + Live.
Fallback base MSRP used when the matched variant has no MSRP of its own.
fields.label: Base Price MSRP

fields.description: Every orderable controller in this family. The configurator resolves a selection to exactly one row.
fields.label: Variants

fields.description: Selectable options exposed by the Webflow configurator, with optional MSRP adders.
fields.label: Allowed Options

fields.description: Fillable PDF used to generate configured spec sheets.
fields.label: Spec Submittal Template
Display Name
fields.description: The product name shown on the website and the spec sheet. The Webflow Product's Product Name copies it. When empty, the Template Name is used.

fields.label: Hero Image Alt Text
fields.description: Describe the main product image for screen readers and search engines.

fields.label: Spec Sheet Public URL
fields.description: Stable link to the current spec sheet. Set when a spec sheet is generated.

fields.label: Specifications
fields.description: Rows with calculated labels are rebuilt on save; rows with other labels are kept. Rows reading TBD, and a temperature range of 0 to 0, are left out (D43).

fields.label: Certifications
fields.description: Copied to the Webflow Product with each brand's badge images.

fields.label: Spec Gallery
fields.description: Other images the spec sheet shows. Section picks where each goes (for example, extra drawings in Dimensions); rows of a section appear in table order.

fields.label: Calculate Configurator on Save
fields.description: When checked, the steps below are rebuilt from this template's options on every save (the Is Required choices are kept). Uncheck it to set the steps up by hand: drag the rows into order and the step numbers follow on save.

fields.label: Part No. Configurator
fields.description: The configurator steps and their allowed values. The website and the dealer portal read them from here.
